question: Do independent paired cover-versus-fallow following-crop-yield data add evidence for the plant-versus-fallow decision?

candidates.design_site: NRCS Plant Materials Research Center, Pullman, Washington
candidates.yield_definition: Winter wheat Yield column reported as kg m^-2; source README says yield is July 2022 wheat yield and lists repeated sample collection times July 2019, July 2020, July 2022.
candidates.water_measurement: README says field volumetric water content (VWC), average of three measurements per plot; measurement depth and exact sample dates are not specified in accessible source metadata.
candidates.identity_gate: SimpleID is explicitly a sample ID, not a documented plot ID. Do not treat it as a plot key or assume repeated rows are independent yields.
decision_context_gaps: CSV could not be retrieved; observed row count, missing outcomes, unique plot IDs, repeated lab sample multiplicity, block mapping and treatment-control joins remain unverified.
One following-wheat yield season at one Pullman site; no independent season-level validation cohort.
Initial soil water at the cover-planting decision is not established; VWC depth and exact observation dates are unspecified.
Exact cover termination timing and plot-level weather linkage are not present in accessible metadata.
Five control plots would be reused across multiple cover-treatment comparisons; pair dependence must be modeled at block level.
candidates.download_status: public metadata accessible; public file requests blocked (file stream HTTP 403; Dryad per-file download API HTTP 401 without bearer token)

candidates.source_evidence: Paper reports aggregate tables and orthogonal contrasts; available PDF contains no row-level plot yields or reusable plot identifiers.
candidates.role: published aggregate evidence/context only; not row-level training labels
